title: Odoo connection
description: Save the Odoo server this company imports from. The API key or account password is stored encrypted and is never shown again.

help.title: About the Odoo connection
help.overview: One Odoo server per company. Import uses this connection over JSON-RPC from the API server.

sections.title: What to enter
sections.body: Use the same URL, database, and login that work in Odoo, plus an API key or that user's password.
items: The URL is the Odoo origin, for example https://your-company.odoo.com.
JSON-RPC authenticate accepts an API key or the account password for that login. Prefer an API key when Odoo provides one.
Leave the secret blank when saving again to keep the value that is already stored.

form.apiKeyPlaceholder: Odoo API key or account password
form.apiKeyHint: Odoo JSON-RPC accepts an API key or the account password for this login.
form.apiKeySetPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the stored secret
form.apiKeySetHint: A secret is already stored. Enter a new API key or password only to replace it.

saveError: Could not save the Odoo connection
